source.title: Pathfinder #162: Ruins of the Radiant Siege

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.text:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of 1d10 days-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with Disintegrate), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

items.name: Sacrilegious Aura
items.text: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a +27 counteract modifier.

items.name: Devastating Blast
items.text:
The graveknight unleashes a 30-foot cone of energy.

Creatures in the area take 10d12 fire damage (DC 37 basic Reflex save save).

The graveknight can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Graveknight's Curse
items.text:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour

Saving Throw DC 43 Will save save

Onset 1 hour

---

Stage 1 Doomed 1 and can't remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 Doomed 2, hampered 10, and can't remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight

items.name: Kharnas's Blessing
items.text:
The graveknight carves the sigil of Kharnas onto an adjacent Immobilized or Unconscious creature.

As long as the creature bears the sigil of Kharnas, it takes a -2 status penalty to saving throws against the abilities of any creature that previously served Kharnas, but it can also freely pass through any hazards that can be bypassed by those bearing the sigil of Kharnas, such as Kharnas's glyphs.

Effect: Kharna's Blessing

items.name: Ruinous Weapons
items.text: Any weapon the graveknight wields gains the effects of the +1 greater striking and greater flaming runes.

items.name: Weapon Master
items.text: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.
